reproduction.summary: Fixed APK: every run with a completed app-origin overview session followed by the card-tap task launch (gesture in F1/F2/F5; direct also completed in F1/F5, and in F2 the direct entry reached Overview late without a tap while its animation cleanup overlapped the gesture) ends with Settings->HOME->APP_SWITCH showing an empty overview 3/3, byte-identical to the original 2026-10-09 morning failure XML. Without any completed app-origin session (F4) the same HOME path passes. The minimal component verified present in all EMPTY runs is a completed gesture overview session with card-tap launch; a direct-only antecedent (no gesture) was not run and remains an open control. Baseline peer under the same input sequence cannot complete app-origin entries (wire mismatch) and the HOME path misfires into launchAsStaticTile([855]) (BFF1; same family as morning candidate2 B1/B3/B5), while repeated HOME-origin usage alone passes (BH1/BH3, morning paired control PASS/PASS).

stuckStateObservations: goToState Normal->Overview completes via LauncherActivityInterface.switchToRecentsIfVisible (logs F1/F2/F5); overview actions bar is present in the UI dump; overview_panel subtree absent from the accessibility dump.

dumpsys activity top in the stuck state shows LauncherRecentsView VISIBLE with 5 TaskView children at x=435..4383 and ClearAllButton at the focused x=162 (F2/F5 hierarchies); the focused page is the clear-all page, no task card is at the focused position.

Final screenshots are uniform background (pixel analysis: dominant color 0x44,0x4C,0x61 across card area and left area; F5-home-final.png == F1-home-final.png region stats), i.e. no card content rendered.

First stuck entry log shows RecentsView reloadIfNeeded - getTasks: -1 with no subsequent applyLoadPlan line (silent exits eliminated: all launcher threads idle in jdb dump; the only logging-free exit inside applyLoadPlan is the mPendingAnimation!=null defer).

A HOME->APP_SWITCH retry in the same stuck state delivered applyLoadPlan with 5 task groups yet the screen and accessibility dump stayed byte-identical empty (F1 recovery probe 23:40 JST), consistent with applyLoadPlan restoring the previous focused page (clear-all) instead of the task page.
Horizontal swipes (left and right) on the stuck overview do not move the pager (F5-swipe1/F5-swipe2 XMLs and post-swipe dumpsys unchanged); no user-escape observed short of launcher force-stop.
signatures all zero in every stuck observation (no unread12, no BadParcelableException, no FATAL, no 5000ms pending timeout) - wire-level errors are not the proximate cause on the fixed APK.

classification.verdict: product bug, pre-existing latent defect in the fork tree, exposed/unmasked by the #559 fix
classification.reasoning: Same input sequence, screen-level: baseline misfires (launcher-initiated launchAsStaticTile [855]) and fixed lands in an empty overview (launcher reached Overview but renders no cards). Both outcomes are launcher-side mishandling of the HOME-origin toggle after app-origin recents activity in the same process; SystemUI delivers the toggle in both. The candidate-latch code (RecentsView/overview state handling) is shared by baseline and fixed and is untouched by the #559 wire change, so the empty-overview mechanism itself predates the fix. The observed screen-level change (baseline misfire -> fixed empty overview) IS attributable to the #559 fix in the limited sense that the fix makes the app-origin overview session complete, which is the antecedent that reaches the latent defect; because the baseline cannot complete that antecedent, this comparison does not prove the baseline would show the same empty overview under an equivalent completed antecedent. Not harness (screen-level, launcher-initiated logged actions on both builds). Not #555.
classification.bugOracle: On the fixed APK (d6f502064...) on this provider: force-stop launcher -> am start Settings -> gesture UP to overview -> verify >=1 task_view_single in uiautomator dump -> tap (540,1200) to return -> HOME key -> 10s dwell -> APP_SWITCH -> dumps at 0/0.5/1/3/6/8s: oracle FAILS if all dumps show 0 task_view_single while dumpsys shows state Overview (expected: >=1 card within 1s). RED 3/3 (F1,F2,F5); PASS control F4 (no completed app-origin session) and BH1/BH3 on baseline.

relatedFindingsNotClassifiedAs563: Cold-start deadlock (separate fork defect, follow-up issue): LawnchairLayoutFactory.fontManager lazy init on ViewPool-init thread blocks on MainThreadInitializedObject.get while main thread waits on the same lazy lock -> launcher ANR/wedge on force-stop restarts. Observed 2026-10-09 23:45-00:16 (H1 full ANR with dropbox trace; BH2/BH4/BH6 wedges).

Transient SystemUiProxy mRecentTasks null bind race on young launcher processes: 'getRecentTasks() failed due to null mRecentTasks' -> RecentTasksList returns INVALID_RESULT -> applyLoadPlan applies an empty taskGroups list once (F1 23:30:43.943), recoverable by later loads.
SystemUI-side TIS rebind gap after launcher restart: overview toggle presses during the gap are dropped (BH5/BH6 no onOverviewToggle in window; binding restored by reinstall or waiting).
